answer: By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round.
